arch_diff:
diff --git a/arch/Kconfig b/arch/Kconfig
index c16381629907..3d0c13490af0 100644
--- a/arch/Kconfig
+++ b/arch/Kconfig
@@ -866,8 +866,12 @@ config LTO_CLANG_THIN
 	  If unsure, say Y.
 endchoice
 
+config ARCH_SUPPORTS_AUTOFDO_CLANG
+	bool
+
 config AUTOFDO_CLANG
 	bool "Enable Clang's AutoFDO build (EXPERIMENTAL)"
+	depends on ARCH_SUPPORTS_AUTOFDO_CLANG
 	depends on CC_IS_CLANG && CLANG_VERSION >= 170000
 	help
 	  This option enables Clang’s AutoFDO build. When
@@ -882,8 +886,12 @@ config AUTOFDO_CLANG
 
 	  If unsure, say N.
 
+config ARCH_SUPPORTS_PROPELLER_CLANG
+	bool
+
 config PROPELLER_CLANG
 	bool "Enable Clang's Propeller build"
+	depends on ARCH_SUPPORTS_PROPELLER_CLANG
 	depends on CC_IS_CLANG && CLANG_VERSION >= 190000
 	depends on $(cc-option,-fbasic-block-sections=list=/dev/null)
 	help
assessment: 3855f9bb8e44 follow-up: whole prior header minus exactly the unused six-line PROPELLER_DATA macro; native x86 linker already emits that section directly and is unchanged. All symbol/CRC/flag/protected tables and text/init/exit patterns remain byte-identical. No CFI or Kprobes section is altered. Generic optional macro is intentionally omitted with the non-x86 expansion; see ext4-config-tail-review.json.

prior.method: Reviewed complete native-LTS-to-port and normalized-ACK-to-port deltas for mixed/source-module build rules, modpost, symbol flags and linker format. Preserve native LTS validation and record excluded ARM64-only FIPS/EL2 glue. Other affected paths have previously completed source witnesses or exact identity/architecture/KMI evidence. Security and scope are in SECURITY.md; compilation and signature results do not claim runtime loading correctness.

include/asm-generic/vmlinux.lds.h.specific_evidence: Reviewed all LTS net changes and confirmed final content equals normalized ACK. Retain explicit function/data subsection support required by selected code-generation paths, while keeping .text.startup[.*] and .text.exit[.*] in dedicated init/exit regions rather than generic TEXT_MAIN. Retain generic optional Propeller data-section support and unified sorted symbol/CRC/flag/protected-export tables consumed by the matching loader. No historical binary layout is retained. Build 31 links the SDK image and modules; runtime relocation/loading is untested.
